invariants: Contains zero model, routing, or execution decisions.
Safe for propagation across threads and process boundaries.

raw_query.description: Original raw query text as entered by the user or client.

origin.description: Originating entry point for the request.

request_id.description: Unique deterministic or random request identifier prefixed with req-.

origin_hwnd.description: HWND of the foreground/origin window at the moment of request capture.

session_id.description: Optional conversational or task session identifier.

dry_run.description: Whether the request is executing under simulated/dry-run mode.
